body:
Redline round 2

Reviewed only the fix diff from round 1 (4d47c84..56334a4).

The round 1 fixes do what their findings asked. `wait` now reads a finished result once, removing the label's files after printing them, so a rerun's wait can no longer return the earlier run's result. A `checks.sh` exit other than 0, 1 or 2 now becomes the wait's exit 5 with a line naming the code, which the checker's step 4 and both workflow prompts already route to `no_result`. The header, the README rows, the checker's description and the standards all say the same thing. The harness now sends the rerun's wait at once and covers the read-once and exit-3 cases. No new correctness problem was found in the fix diff. Two limits on this review: the reviewer's guard refuses `tests/background-test.sh`, so the harness was traced by reading, not run. The dead-pid case (a wait sent before the next start clears a killed run's pid exits 5) is the limitation round 1 accepted and recorded, so it is not raised again. Nothing scheduled or queued writes `$TMPDIR/redline-background/`.

No findings.
